name: The Things We Dream
source:
As your alarm starts ringing, you realize you need to get up and get ready for work.

Instead, you find yourself trapped in your dreams, unable to wake up, and chased by a mysterious creature.

[From [url=https://lasy-otter.itch.io/the-things-we-dream]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当闹钟响起时，你意识到自己需要起床准备工作。

相反，你发现自己被困在梦中无法醒来，并被神秘生物追赶。

[来自[url=https://lasy-otter.itch.io/the-things-we-dream]Itch.io[/url]]
